Name: (CP) Sam Mullet Replacement
Author: Rosenbug
Description:
[center]He's just a lil guy who deserves some better hair :')

[b][color=#e69138]༻ Now updated for 1.6 ༺[/color][/b]

≿━━━━༺❀༻━━━━≾

This is my first mod, and my first time doing pixel art, so let me know if you encounter any problems :')

[b]**[/b] PLEASE DON'T UPLOAD MY MODS TO OTHER SITES WITHOUT MY PERMISSION [b]**[/b][/center][center]﻿[/center][center]≿━━━━༺❀༻━━━━≾

[b]Installation[/b]:
1. Download and unpack the zip file.
2. Place the "[CP] Sam Mullet Replacement" folder in your mods folder.
3. Enjoy <3

Or install through vortex
